description: Link to the restaurant's TableCheck booking page with the course, date and party size already selected. The guest picks a time there, agrees to the restaurant's notice, enters their name and contact, and confirms. This tool never books, never takes payment and does not know which times are free. Refuses dates the restaurant has told us it is closed.
